item.title: Former THE LION KING Star Imani Dia Smith Has Died at 25
item.description: Imani Dia Smith, who previously starred as Young Nala on Broadway in Disney’s Lion King, has died at the age of 25. Smith was killed by her boyfriend, Jordan Jackson-Small, who has been charged with murder, weapon possession crimes and endangering the welfare of a child. Smith leaves behind a 3-year-old son, her parents, her two younger siblings. A GoFundMe has been organized to support Imani’s parents, with the goal of raising $50,000. item.title: Cole Escola, Cynthia Nixon, and Others Join NYC Mayor-Elect Zohran Mamdani's Inaugural Committee
item.description: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani announced the members of his inaugural committee, including familiar theater faces like Cole Escola, Cynthia Nixon, John Turturro, and Julio Torres. The 48-person committee, with members all across New York City, helped in the planning process for Mamdani's upcoming inauguration, and will serve as hosts for the ceremony. item.title: Kristen Bell to Star in New Musical Comedy THREE MONTHS LATER; 3-day run in Los Angeles
item.description: Kristen Bell, Lea Thompson, and Camille Chen will star in a new musical comedy, Three Months Later, which will play a three-day engagement at the Jim Henson Studios in Los Angeles this February. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the show follows a flight crash landing in the middle of nowhere, with 100 passengers on board.
